What is this surface?这个界面是什么？

Purpose: This page shows the bottom-sensor envelope — a set of descriptive state labels assigned to every US stock each nightly run. It is a QA surface, not a signal board.

These labels are display-only. They rank nothing, gate nothing, and trigger no alerts. No label here has earned ranking authority in a pre-registered backtest family. Promotion of any label to ranking or gating authority requires its own pre-registered study with a published protocol.

State meanings (v1): HOLD_LAUNCHED = a name the hold engine has marked as launched (take-anchored). FRESH_FIRE_DURABLE_CAND = fresh T1–T3 signal within 2 ticks, coiled setup, near 21-day low. FRESH_FIRE_TACTICAL = fresh T1–T3 signal, not coiled. CHASE_RISK = signal present but stale or far from low. DEAD_MONEY_RISK = hold engine shows basing with minimal movement. EARLY_WATCH = drawing down from 126-day high with a near cross-signal. KNIFE_RISK = knife-block condition binding. WATCH = default.

Overlays: EVENT_BLACKOUT = earnings within 3 trading days (per-row fresh rule). COILED = volatility compressed. STAR = high-conviction setup flag.

Missing fields render as a dash (—). Sponsorship state arrives in a parallel PR (lane B2). RS repair state is stamped unavailable until Entry Intelligence #1302 W0.4 series exists.

用途：本页展示底部传感器包络——每次夜间运行为每支美股分配的描述性状态标签集合。这是一个质量保证（QA）界面，不是信号板。

这些标签仅用于展示。不进行排名、不作为门控条件、不触发任何警报。此处任何标签均未在预注册回测家族中获得排名权限。任何标签若要升级为排名或门控权限，需通过独立的、具有公开协议的预注册研究。

状态含义（v1）：HOLD_LAUNCHED = 持有引擎标记为已启动的标的（以成交价为锚点）。FRESH_FIRE_DURABLE_CAND = 2个周期内的T1–T3新鲜信号，且处于蓄势状态、接近21日低点。FRESH_FIRE_TACTICAL = 新鲜T1–T3信号，未处于蓄势状态。CHASE_RISK = 信号存在但陈旧或远离低点。DEAD_MONEY_RISK = 持有引擎显示横盘整理且价格变动极小。EARLY_WATCH = 从126日高点下跌且接近交叉信号。KNIFE_RISK = 刀锋阻断条件触发。WATCH = 默认状态。

叠加标志：EVENT_BLACKOUT = 3个交易日内有财报（逐行实时规则）。COILED = 波动压缩。STAR = 高确信度形态标志。

缺失字段显示为横线（—）。赞助状态将由并行PR（通道B2）提供。RS修复状态标注为不可用，直至入场智能#1302 W0.4系列数据可用。

Display-only. Labels are descriptive and rank nothing. Not investment advice.仅展示。标签为描述性，无排名权限。不构成投资建议。  ·  Entry Stack Amendment 1, Lane B0  ·  labels_version: labels_v1
